verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.adyen.com that explicitly covers Issuing. The Issuing docs pages are also served as markdown (.md URLs such as relayed-authorisation.md and manage-cards.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs, the full llms.txt contents beyond the truncated header (the /issuing/.md root returned 404), and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404).
